description: Turn any topic, event, or supported public webpage into a playable, AI-hosted trivia gameshow. Make a quick 5-question round, a balanced 7-question game, or a 10-question challenge in 10 languages. Choose one of eight host personalities—or let Trivana cast one for your topic. Preview and answer a sample question inside ChatGPT, then open the unlisted Trivana link for the complete free-to-play game with automatic scoring. Players do not need an account. Share it for game night, family play, classroom warm-ups, team icebreakers, parties, clubs, or live events. When the private card offers Claim your game, use it to take ownership and view play results. Community and search publication is a separate creator opt-in on Trivana after confirming publication rights; quality and traction checks still apply. Voice availability varies by host, language, and production level.
